Strategic data asset management.description_en:
In today's digital workplace, information has become a strategic asset that must be safeguarded and managed properly. This course provides a practical guide to the information management (IM) methods, tools and activities that support an effective departmental IM program. Participants will learn how to use a function-based classification structure, establish retention specifications and follow the proper process for disposing of information resources.

Topics include:

• applying function-based methodologies 

• documenting practices and procedures 

• developing retention specifications to facilitate the disposition process

Prerequisites:

Information Management: Supporting Programs and Services (I230) is a prerequisite for this course.

Notes:

This course is divided into three 3 hour sessions scheduled over a one-week period.
Strategic data asset management.title_fr: Méthodes et outils de gestion de l'information (COR509)
Strategic data asset management.description_fr:
Dans l'environnement de travail numérique d'aujourd'hui, l'information est devenue une ressource stratégique qui doit être protégée et gérée adéquatement. Ce cours présente de façon concrète les méthodes, les outils et les activités de gestion de l'information (GI) qui favorisent l'efficacité des programmes ministériels de GI. Les participants apprendront à utiliser une structure de classification basée sur les fonctions, à établir des critères de conservation et à suivre les démarches appropriées pour éliminer des ressources documentaires.

Sujets traités :

• appliquer des méthodes axées sur les fonctions; 

• consigner les pratiques et les procédures; 

• établir des critères de conservation afin de simplifier le processus de disposition.

Préalables :

Le cours La gestion de l'information à l'appui des programmes et des services (I230) est un préalable à ce cours.

Remarques :

Ce cours est divisé en trois séances de 3 heures réparties sur une semaine.

As the world and technology changes, organizations are constantly looking for new ways to adapt and transform themselves. This online self-paced course provides an overview of how to build digital dexterity within an organization to ensure its readiness for potential business opportunities. Participants will be introduced to the four characteristics of a digital organization and learn about strategies to sustain a successful digital transformation.

Option appraisal and prioritization.description_en:
Departments and agencies use a variety of solicitation methods to acquire goods and services through competitive contracts. This course covers two critical elements of the solicitation process: the statement of work and the evaluation criteria for bids submitted. Participants will learn how to write proper requirements to obtain their desired product or service and how to set evaluation criteria that will help select the appropriate bidder.

Topics include:

• identifying the components of a proper statement of work
• understanding the implications of trade agreements
• defining the requirements of the contract
• assessing, managing and mitigating contract risks
• selecting a contractor

Notes:

To gain a better understanding of the subject matter, participants are strongly recommended to complete Overview of Procurement (COR403) or the combination of Procurement Fundamental (COR401) and The Procurement Process (COR402) before registering to COR407.

Strategic investment prioritization.description_en:
The financial resources of the Government of Canada are safeguarded through balanced controls that enable flexibility and manage risk. This course for seasoned executives examines the principles and processes behind strategic resourcing and financial management, as well as the important role played by central agencies. Through practical workshops, participants will explore challenges, reflect on current practices and engage with colleagues to identify best practices for effectively securing the resources needed to deliver on their organizational mandate.

 

Topics include: 

- examining accountability and stewardship 


- managing finances and achieving results
- seeking authorizations and securing resources
- reporting on results and measuring performance
- advocating for proper financial resources

 

Notes: 

This course is delivered as two consecutive days of training. Registration is reserved for employees at the EX-02 and EX-03 levels. A short readiness questionnaire will be administered prior to the offering date to enable full participation in class discussions.

 

A valid Authority Delegation Validation Assessment for Executives (COR254) certificate is a required prerequisite for this course. Certifications are valid for five years.

 

Executive employees registering for COR215 are encouraged to also complete the Authority Delegation Training: Using Public Funds Responsibly (COR250) to refresh their understanding of the core principles of financial management.

 

To express your interest in participating in this course, please submit a readiness questionnaire.

Strategic investment prioritization.title_en: Authority Delegation Validation Assessment for Executives (COR254)
Strategic investment prioritization.description_en:
As part of their daily responsibilities, executives in the public service must make sound decisions in compliance with the key legislation and policy frameworks governing their delegated authorities. This online self-paced revalidation assessment provides public service executives with helpful guidance on exercising their delegated authorities. Participants will examine a series of multifaceted scenarios that build upon the courses included in the Authority Delegation Training Program.

 

Topics include:

 

- functioning in the government's accountability framework
- reviewing the responsibilities and roles of executives
- leading and managing people
- procuring and managing public funds, programs and assets

 

Notes:

 

Learners must successfully complete this assessment five years after their initial certifications to revalidate their ability to exercise their delegated authorities. Completing the authority delegation training and assessments does not entitle you to exercise signing authority. Consult the Directive on Delegation of Spending and Financial Authorities for the specific conditions.

 

Participants must complete the scenarios, exercises and validation questions in their entirety to complete this assessment.

 

Learn more about the Authority Delegation Training Program.

Portfolio and gate review governance.description_en:
The ability to manage projects is a transferable and indispensable skill for public servants at all levels. This online self-paced course provides the foundational knowledge needed to explore and explain what project management is and how it applies to both professional and personal projects. Participants will be introduced to the key concepts and players, different project management approaches, and the four stages of the project life cycle: initiation, planning, execution, and close-out.

Topics include:

·       introducing the key concepts, principles and constraints (the "what" of project management)

·       identifying the stakeholders and the different stages of the project life cycle (the "who" and "when" of project management)

·       exploring project management approaches and methodologies (the "how" of project management)

 

Notes:

This course has been determined by the Secretary of the Treasury Board to be mandatory for project management specialists.

This course is intended for all public servants, especially for those who have little or no project management experience.
Portfolio and gate review governance.title_fr: Introduction à la gestion de projet (TRN322)
Portfolio and gate review governance.description_fr:
La capacité de gérer des projets est une compétence transférable et indispensable pour les fonctionnaires de tous les niveaux. Ce cours en ligne à rythme libre fournit les connaissances de base nécessaires pour explorer et expliquer ce qu'est la gestion de projet et comment elle s'applique aux projets professionnels et personnels. Les participants découvriront les notions, les acteurs clés et les différentes approches en matière de gestion de projet ainsi que les quatre étapes du cycle de vie d'un projet : lancement, planification, exécution et clôture.

Sujets traités :

·       découvrir les notions, principes et contraintes clés (le « quoi » de la gestion de projet);

·       présenter les intervenants et les différentes étapes du cycle de vie d'un projet (le « qui » et le « quand » de la gestion de projet);

·       explorer les approches et les méthodologies en matière de gestion de projet (le « comment » de la gestion de projet).

 

Remarques :

Ce cours a été jugé obligatoire par le Secrétariat du Conseil du Trésor pour les spécialistes en gestion de projet.

Ce cours s'adresse à tous les fonctionnaires, en particulier aux personnes qui souhaitent s'initier à la gestion de projet.

Digital intake and triage analysis.description_en:
Not to be confused with project management, business analysis offers a unique value to project work. This online self-paced course explores the purpose and benefits of business analysis, and activities such as elicitation, traceability and monitoring, solution evaluation, and needs assessment. Participants will examine the business analyst role, identify its responsibilities, and learn best practices for using product roadmaps and validating project requirements.

 

Topics include:

- explaining the responsibilities of a business analyst
- exploring needs assessment, stakeholder engagement, solution evaluation, and business analysis elicitation activities
- identifying business analysis processes for traceability and monitoring

 

Notes:

This course is intended for all public servants, including those with or without project management experience. Materials are aligned with the PMBOK® Guide – Seventh Edition.

Completion of the 26 courses in the CAPM® course series can count towards the eligibility requirements for the Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM®) exam administered for a fee by the Project Management Institute (PMI).
 
The CAPM® exam is not administered by the Canada School of Public Service. Learners wishing to take the exam are responsible for validating their eligibility directly with PMI.
Digital intake and triage analysis.description_fr:
L'analyse d’affaires, à ne pas confondre avec la gestion de projet, offre une valeur unique au travail lié au projet. Ce cours en ligne à rythme libre permet d'explorer le but et les avantages de l'analyse commerciale et des activités telles que la collecte d'informations, la traçabilité et le suivi, ainsi que l'évaluation des besoins et des solutions. Les participants examineront le rôle et les responsabilités de l'analyste d’affaires et apprendront les pratiques exemplaires de l'utilisation de feuilles de route de produits et de la validation des exigences d'un projet.


Sujets traités :

- expliquer quelles sont les responsabilités d'un analyste d’affaires;
- explorer les activités de collecte d'informations pour l'évaluation des besoins, la mobilisation des parties prenantes, l'évaluation des solutions et l'analyse d’affaires;
- cerner les processus d'analyse d’affaires pour la traçabilité et la surveillance.


Remarques :

Ce cours s'adresse à tous les fonctionnaires, qu'ils aient ou non de l'expérience en gestion de projet. Le matériel est conforme à la septième édition du Guide PMBOK®.

La réussite des 26 cours de série de cours CAPM® peut être prise en compte dans les conditions d’admissibilité à l’examen payant d’Associé certifié en gestion de projet (CAPM®) du Project Management Institute (PMI).
 
L’examen CAPM® n’est pas offert par l’École de la fonction publique du Canada. Les apprenants qui souhaitent le passer sont responsables de vérifier leur admissibilité directement auprès du PMI.
